meta.title: Interactive Demo — PromptBox
meta.description: No install required. Walk through PromptBox in your browser: card variables, starting the MCP server, hiding cards from AI, and consent-gated release of secret cards.

hero.title: Try it before you install it
hero.lead: PromptBox is on the left, an external AI client on the right. Four steps show you exactly how it is decided what AI can and cannot reach — all running in your browser, nothing is sent anywhere.

disclaimer.title: An interactive illustration, not the actual app
disclaimer.body: The flow is simplified to explain the concept: tool names, ports and connection details differ from the real MCP interface. The demo does no real encryption — any password you type stays in this browser tab's memory and is gone when you close it. The demo interface is currently in Traditional Chinese only.

mobile.title: This demo needs a desktop-width screen
mobile.body: The demo is two side-by-side windows and gets cropped on phones. Please open this page on a computer, or see the screenshot below.
mobile.imageAlt: The PromptBox interactive demo: card box on the left, external AI client on the right

cta.title: Seen enough? Get the real one
cta.body: Everything in the demo is a real feature of the app. Encryption is free forever, with no limits.
